meta.name: crawl4ai
meta.description: Use when scraping JavaScript-heavy pages or SPAs, crawling multiple URLs concurrently, extracting structured data with reusable CSS/JSON schemas, or building automated web data pipelines. Wraps the Crawl4AI library (`crwl` CLI and Python SDK) with schema-generation patterns for LLM-free extraction. Triggers on crawl4ai, crwl, scrape JS-heavy site, scrape SPA, headless browser scrape, schema-based extraction, batch crawl, sitemap crawl, web data pipeline. SKIP when a static HTML page can be read with `defuddle` / `fetch-web` — those are faster cold-start and don't need a browser.

copy.tagline: 用浏览器引擎自动抓取 JavaScript 渲染的网页数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从 JavaScript 重度网站或 SPA 中提取数据。
